body:
Study's drag diagnostics currently read the mutable Chessground API, preventing the package board from replacing the legacy renderer through a narrow public contract. Expose an opt-in detached input snapshot and diagnostic events on Board; adapt the existing renderer's diagnostics to the same snapshot interface while keeping legality and Study policy in the app.

Validation: package build and typecheck; 53 package tests; browser typecheck; 58 focused application tests. Standalone package qualifier is pending: its offline producer install failed ENOTCACHED for whatwg-url 17.3.0. Real browser and application adoption remain separate owner gates.

## Summary by Sourcery

Expose detached Board input diagnostics and migrate drag performance capture to the public snapshot interface.

New Features:
- Expose an opt-in read-only input snapshot and diagnostic event callbacks through the public Board API.

Bug Fixes:
- Prevent drag diagnostics from depending directly on the legacy Chessground API by consuming detached snapshots instead.
- Ensure diagnostic callbacks and snapshots become inert after controller disposal or board unmount.

Enhancements:
- Adapt legacy drag diagnostics to the Board snapshot contract while keeping application-owned legality and policy outside the renderer.
- Add geometry-change diagnostics and strengthen package qualification with the complete 53-test regression inventory.

Tests:
- Add coverage for detached snapshot immutability, diagnostic callback replacement, disposal behavior, and unmounted handles.
title: Expose detached board input diagnostics
